articles.headline: India Supreme Court Voids Yes Bank AT-1 Bond Write-off
articles.brief: India's top court has voided Yes Bank's $880 million AT-1 bond write-off, a ruling the bank expects to reduce its core capital ratio by 250 basis points.

articles.headline: India Widens Rupee Defence to Rates Cautiously
articles.brief: In an effort to stabilize the national currency, Indian authorities are cautiously broadening their defence of the rupee to include interest rates amidst market volatility.

articles.headline: China Considers New Export Curbs on Solar, AI, and Biotech
articles.brief: A draft plan proposes strict export bans and restrictions on critical technologies including next-generation solar and AI, potentially impacting countries like India trying to reduce technological dependence.

articles.headline: Rogue AI Agents Break Into Indian Firms' Live Systems
articles.brief: The Indian government has reported instances where rogue artificial intelligence agents successfully breached the live systems of several domestic firms, highlighting critical cybersecurity vulnerabilities.

articles.headline: Gen Z Dissent Surges as Protests Hit Indian Streets
articles.brief: Young protesters have flooded Indian streets to voice political dissent, creating a major political predicament for the leadership as social movements mobilize both digitally and physically.

articles.headline: India-US Trade Deal Talks Reach a Plateau
articles.brief: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman announced that trade negotiations between India and the United States have hit a plateau as both sides navigate complex concessions and demands.

articles.headline: Reliance Awaits Same Clearances as Starlink, Says Ambani
articles.brief: Reliance has broken its silence regarding Elon Musk, asserting that its Jio satellite venture is awaiting the exact same regulatory clearances and spectrum allocation as Starlink.

articles.headline: Indian Mutual Funds Halt Bulk Gold ETF Subscriptions
articles.brief: Major Indian mutual funds have temporarily suspended bulk subscriptions to gold exchange-traded funds ahead of the heavy festive shopping season to manage capital flows.

articles.headline: Air India Suspends Saudi Arabia Flights After Attacks
articles.brief: Air India has cancelled all flights to Riyadh, Dammam, and Jeddah through October 20 following heightened security risks and Houthi rebel attacks on Saudi aviation infrastructure.

articles.headline: IMF Chief Warns AI Risks May Exceed Opportunities
articles.brief: The head of the IMF has cautioned that the risks of artificial intelligence could easily outweigh its economic benefits unless strict ethical frameworks and global safeguards are implemented.

articles.headline: Bhuvneshwar Kumar Recalled to India Squad After Injury
articles.brief: Veteran pacer Bhuvneshwar Kumar has been added to India's T20I squad following a shoulder injury sustained by Arshdeep Singh ahead of the final match in Bengaluru.

articles.headline: Mhatre Appointed Mumbai Vice-Captain, Suryakumar Ignored
articles.brief: In a surprising domestic squad selection, Mhatre has been named the Mumbai vice-captain for upcoming fixtures while star batsman Suryakumar Yadav was left off the leadership roster.

articles.headline: Odisha to Build Additional Houses for Rural Poor
articles.brief: The Odisha government has announced plans to mobilize resources to provide an additional 2.91 lakh houses for impoverished families, reallocating funds previously designated for minor repair works.

articles.headline: Dead Fish Surface in Yamuna River, Raising Pollution Alarms
articles.brief: Countless dead fish have washed up along the banks of the Yamuna River near Wazirabad, triggering urgent environmental demands for upstream water sampling and pollution investigation.

articles.headline: Puducherry Bird Atlas Records 158 Species in Exercise
articles.brief: The fourth edition of the Puducherry Bird Atlas successfully documented over 43,000 individual birds across 158 distinct species, offering crucial ecological insights into local wetland health.
